name: New Jersey
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. New Jersey's extent (Census TIGER, rounded outward): the Delaware River in the west, Cape May in the south, the Hudson in the east. The east edge stops at the Hudson waterfront and Sandy Hook, so open Atlantic east of the shore is trimmed; the ocean off the southern shore inside the box cannot be. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-nj.
